title: 7 Costs a Godly Man Pays Before Anyone Calls Him a Leader
caption:
7 costs a godly man pays before anyone calls him a leader.

Nobody claps for the ones that count. The apology you gave before anyone demanded it. The credit you let someone else take. The early morning nobody scheduled you for. Galatians 6:9 doesn't promise the applause lands on time.

The hard conversation you didn't put off. The plan you scrapped because it served you more than the room. The moment you went first with no guarantee anyone would follow.

That's the whole definition. You went anyway.

#faith #leadership #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #character
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
